shell.credit: A Ministry of Digital Technologies system

demo.popover: Demonstration mode. All data in this system was created for testing.

member.title: Your work will appear here
member.body: Nothing yet. You can find any page through search.

admin.title: The system is running
admin.body: No departments yet. You can check system status on the administration page.

error.title: Could not load the data
error.body: Try again. If it happens again, send the request number to your administrator.

denied.title: This page is not open to you
denied.body: This page is for the system administrator only. If you need access, ask your head of department.

offline.empty: This page will open once the connection is back.

notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: The link may be out of date or incorrect.

login.title: Sign in
login.locked: The account is temporarily locked. Try again in 15 minutes.
login.offline: Try again when the connection is back.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: The system administrator has already been created.

login2fa.title: Two-step verification
login2fa.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login2fa.error: That code is wrong or expired. Try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Set up an account to start using Devon.

error.conflict: That login is already taken. Choose another.
error.generic: Could not register. Check your details and try again.

sessions.title: Devices and sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every device currently signed in to your account.
sessions.revokeAllConfirm: You'll be signed out on every device, including this one. Continue?

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.subtitle: Add an authenticator app as a second layer of protection.

enroll.step1: Step 1: scan the QR or enter the key
enroll.error: That code is wrong. Check your device's clock.
enroll.recoveryBody: These are shown once. Use one to sign in if you lose access to your phone.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.warning: Your account will be permanently deleted and your personal data anonymised after 30 days. You can cancel any time before then.
delete.confirmDialog: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
delete.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.confirm: Create a temporary password for this user and end all of their sessions?

landing.title: Create a department or join one
landing.body: You don't belong to a department yet. Create a new one or join an existing one.

create.title: New department request
create.subtitle: Your request goes to the super admin; the department is created once approved.
create.name: Department name

pending.title: Your request is under review
pending.body: The super admin will review your request soon.

invite.title: Invite
invite.rotateKeyConfirm: The old link will stop working. Rotate the key?
invite.rotatePasswordConfirm: The old password will stop working. Rotate the password?
invite.approvalToggleBody: When on, new members wait for the head's approval.
invite.passwordHiddenNotice: For security, the password is shown only right after it's created or rotated.
invite.saveNowWarning: Save this now -- it won't be shown again.

join.title: Join a department

byForm.title: Join with a key and password

join.pendingApproval: Your request is waiting for the head's approval
join.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.

members.title: Members
members.leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave this department?
members.leaveBlockedHead: Transfer headship to someone else first.
members.transferConfirm: Headship will be transferred to {name}. Continue?

settings.title: Department settings
settings.name: Name
settings.allowSelfAssign: Members can assign themselves to units
settings.telegramGroupLabel: Who can connect a Telegram group
settings.requestDeletionConfirm: The super admin will review this request. Continue?
